title: Love a Park Day - Bicentennial Park Mural Painting
description:
Ann Arbor Parks Volunteer Program for a special community volunteer event as we help welcome the park’s new splash pad with the creation of a colorful outdoor mural. As part of the recent park renovations, volunteers will assist with painting a pre-designed mural on the exterior wall of the restroom and changing building. title: Ann Arbor Farmers Market Saturday Market Regular Hours
Fuller Park: FREE Party in the Park
description:
Get ready for afternoons filled with music, games, creativity and community fun as the free Party in the Parks series returns this summer — with two events across Ann Arbor parks! Enjoy live music from local performers, hands-on crafts, lawn games and food.


2026 Party in the Parks Schedule:
* Saturday, June 27 — Fuller Park: Performances by the Ann Arbor Civic Band followed by the Island Guys Steel Drum Duo. 1519 Fuller Road


* Saturday, Aug. 15 — West Park


Bring your friends, family, picnic blankets and dancing shoes for a fun-filled afternoon in the park! You can also hot dogs, chicken/philly and fish sandwiches, mac + cheese, potato salad, desserts/drinks from Touch of Honey food truck.

title: Ann Arbor Farmers Market Saturday Market Regular Hours
Bicentennial Splash Pad Grand Opening
description:
The community is invited to celebrate the grand opening of the Bicentennial Splash Pad (2901 E. Ellsworth Road) with an afternoon of free, family-friendly activities. The celebration will feature:
  • Official opening of Ann Arbor's first splash pad
  • Live DJ and music
  • Food truck and Kona Ice
  • Family games and activities
  • Water-themed activities
  • Fire truck display
  • Olympian and Paralympian-themed activities
  • Remarks from Mayor Christopher Taylor and local Olympians and Paralympians
The event will also highlight new Olympian and Paralympian interpretive signage installed at Bicentennial Park, recognizing Ann Arbor's rich history of Olympic and Paralympic achievement.
